   383→def extract_from_md(md):
   384→    """从 markdown 提取产品名和型号"""
   385→    seen = set()
   386→    items = []
   387→
   388→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   389→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   390→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   391→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   392→
   393→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   394→            continue
   395→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   396→            continue
   397→
   398→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   399→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   400→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   401→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   402→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   403→            continue
   404→
   405→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   406→            if name not in seen:
   407→                seen.add(name)
   408→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   409→
   410→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   411→    model_rx = [
   412→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   413→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   414→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   415→    ]
   416→    for rx in model_rx:
   417→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   418→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   419→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   420→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   421→                    if model not in seen:
   422→                        seen.add(model)
   423→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   424→
   425→    return items[:30]

   428→def extract_amazon(md):
   429→    """Amazon 页面产品提取"""
   430→    products = []
   431→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   432→    lines = md.split('\n')
   433→    cur = {}
   434→
   435→    for line in lines:
   436→        line = line.strip()
   437→        if not line:
   438→            if cur.get('name'):
   439→                products.append(cur)
   440→                cur = {}
   441→            continue
   442→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   443→            continue
   444→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   445→            if not cur.get('name'):
   446→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   447→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   448→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   449→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   450→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   451→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   452→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   453→
   454→    if cur.get('name'):
   455→        products.append(cur)
   456→    return products[:10]

   459→def filter_fresh(articles):
   460→    """过滤 2024 年之前的新闻"""
   461→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   462→    out = []
   463→    for a in articles:
   464→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   465→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   466→        if years:
   467→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   468→                out.append(a)
   469→        else:
   470→            out.append(a)
   471→    return out

   383→def extract_from_md(md):

   385→    seen = set()
   386→    items = []
   387→
   388→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   389→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):

   418→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   419→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   420→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   421→                    if model not in seen:

   430→    products = []
   431→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   432→    lines = md.split('\n')
   433→    cur = {}

   437→        if not line:

   442→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   443→            continue
   444→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):

   447→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)

   450→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)

   459→def filter_fresh(articles):

   469→        else:
   470→            out.append(a)

   385→def extract_from_md(md):

   387→    seen = set()
   388→    items = []

   390→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   391→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):

   397→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):

   399→
   400→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   401→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   402→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   403→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   404→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   408→            if name not in seen:
   409→                seen.add(name)

   411→
   412→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   413→    model_rx = [
   414→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   415→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',

   418→    for rx in model_rx:

   420→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   421→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   422→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   423→                    if model not in seen:
   424→                        seen.add(model)
   425→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})

   427→    return items[:30]

   385→def extract_from_md(md):
   386→    """从 markdown 提取产品名和型号"""
   387→    seen = set()
   388→    items = []
   389→
   390→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   391→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   392→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   393→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   394→
   395→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   396→            continue
   397→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   398→            continue
   399→
   400→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   401→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   402→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   403→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   404→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   408→            if name not in seen:
   409→                seen.add(name)
   410→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   411→
   412→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   413→    model_rx = [
   414→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   415→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   416→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   417→    ]
   418→    for rx in model_rx:
   419→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   420→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   421→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   422→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   423→                    if model not in seen:
   424→                        seen.add(model)
   425→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   426→
   427→    return items[:30]

   430→def extract_amazon(md):
   431→    """Amazon 页面产品提取"""
   432→    products = []
   433→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   434→    lines = md.split('\n')
   435→    cur = {}
   436→
   437→    for line in lines:
   438→        line = line.strip()
   439→        if not line:
   440→            if cur.get('name'):
   441→                products.append(cur)
   442→                cur = {}
   443→            continue
   444→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   445→            continue
   446→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   447→            if not cur.get('name'):
   448→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   449→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   450→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   451→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   452→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   453→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   454→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   455→
   456→    if cur.get('name'):
   457→        products.append(cur)
   458→    return products[:10]

   385→def extract_from_md(md):
   386→    """从 markdown 提取产品名和型号"""
   387→    seen = set()
   388→    items = []
   389→
   390→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   391→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   392→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   393→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   394→
   395→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   396→            continue
   397→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   398→            continue
   399→
   400→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   401→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   402→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   403→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   404→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   408→            if name not in seen:
   409→                seen.add(name)
   410→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   411→
   412→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   413→    model_rx = [
   414→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   415→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   416→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   417→    ]
   418→    for rx in model_rx:
   419→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   420→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   421→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   422→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   423→                    if model not in seen:
   424→                        seen.add(model)
   425→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   426→
   427→    return items[:30]

   430→def extract_amazon(md):
   431→    """Amazon 页面产品提取"""
   432→    products = []
   433→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   434→    lines = md.split('\n')
   435→    cur = {}
   436→
   437→    for line in lines:
   438→        line = line.strip()
   439→        if not line:
   440→            if cur.get('name'):
   441→                products.append(cur)
   442→                cur = {}
   443→            continue
   444→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   445→            continue
   446→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   447→            if not cur.get('name'):
   448→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   449→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   450→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   451→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   452→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   453→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   454→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   455→
   456→    if cur.get('name'):
   457→        products.append(cur)
   458→    return products[:10]

   461→def filter_fresh(articles):
   462→    """过滤 2024 年之前的新闻"""
   463→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   464→    out = []
   465→    for a in articles:
   466→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   467→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   468→        if years:
   469→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   470→                out.append(a)
   471→        else:
   472→            out.append(a)
   473→    return out

    72→def _ctx():

    78→def mcp_call(mcp_url, tool, args, timeout=60):
    79→    """通过 MCP 网关调用工具，兼容 SSE 格式响应"""
    80→    body = json.dumps({
    81→        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    82→        "id": 1,
    83→        "method": "tools/call",
    84→        "params": {"name": tool, "arguments": args}
    85→    }).encode('utf-8')
    86→
    87→    req = urllib.request.Request(mcp_url, data=body, method='POST')
    88→    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    89→    req.add_header('X-Platform-Access-Key', ACCESS_KEY)
    90→
    91→    try:
    92→        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=_ctx(), timeout=timeout) as resp:
    93→            raw = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
    94→    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    95→        return {"error": f"HTTP {e.code}: {str(e)[:200]}"}
    96→    except Exception as e:
    97→        return {"error": str(e)[:200]}
    98→
    99→    # 解析 SSE 格式: event:message\ndata:{json}\n\n
   100→    if 'event:' in raw or 'data:' in raw:
   101→        for line in raw.split('\n'):
   102→            if line.startswith('data:'):
   103→                data_str = line[5:].strip()
   104→                if data_str:
   105→                    try:
   106→                        return json.loads(data_str)
   107→                    except:
   108→                        continue
   109→
   110→    # 回退：直接 JSON 解析
   111→    try:
   112→        return json.loads(raw)
   113→    except:
   114→        return {"error": "无法解析响应", "raw": raw[:500]}

   385→def extract_from_md(md):

   387→    seen = set()
   388→    items = []

   390→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   391→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):

   397→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):

   400→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   401→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   402→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   403→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   404→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   408→            if name not in seen:
   409→                seen.add(name)
   410→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   411→
   412→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   413→    model_rx = [
   414→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   415→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',

   418→    for rx in model_rx:

   420→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   421→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   422→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   423→                    if model not in seen:

   425→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})

   427→    return items[:30]

   385→def extract_from_md(md):
   386→    """从 markdown 提取产品名和型号"""
   387→    seen = set()
   388→    items = []
   389→
   390→    # 1) 解析 markdown 链接 [name](url)
   391→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   392→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   393→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   394→
   395→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   396→            continue
   397→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   398→            continue
   399→
   400→        skip = ['home', 'support', 'cart', 'account', 'login', 'sign', 'menu',
   401→                'search', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'footer',
   402→                'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap', 'wishlist',
   403→                'compare', 'store', 'find', 'chat', 'warranty', 'delivery', 'help']
   404→        if any(w in url.lower() or w in name.lower() for w in skip):
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   408→            if name not in seen:
   409→                seen.add(name)
   410→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   411→
   412→    # 2) 正则匹配纯型号
   413→    model_rx = [
   414→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   415→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   416→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   417→    ]
   418→    for rx in model_rx:
   419→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   420→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   421→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   422→                if not re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   423→                    if model not in seen:
   424→                        seen.add(model)
   425→                        items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   426→
   427→    return items[:30]

   430→def extract_amazon(md):
   431→    """Amazon 页面产品提取"""
   432→    products = []
   433→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   434→    lines = md.split('\n')
   435→    cur = {}
   436→
   437→    for line in lines:
   438→        line = line.strip()
   439→        if not line:
   440→            if cur.get('name'):
   441→                products.append(cur)
   442→                cur = {}
   443→            continue
   444→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   445→            continue
   446→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   447→            if not cur.get('name'):
   448→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   449→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   450→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   451→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   452→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   453→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   454→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   455→
   456→    if cur.get('name'):
   457→        products.append(cur)
   458→    return products[:10]

   385→def extract_from_md(md):

   445→            continue

   452→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)

   461→def filter_fresh(articles):
   462→    """过滤 2024 年之前的新闻"""
   463→    this_year = datetime.now().year

   468→        if years:
   469→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   470→                out.append(a)
   471→        else:
   472→            out.append(a)
   473→    return out

    71→def mcp_call(mcp_url, tool, args, timeout=60):
    72→    body = json.dumps({
    73→        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    74→        "id": 1,
    75→        "method": "tools/call",
    76→        "params": {"name": tool, "arguments": args}
    77→    }).encode('utf-8')
    78→
    79→    req = urllib.request.Request(mcp_url, data=body, method='POST')
    80→    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    81→    req.add_header('X-Platform-Access-Key', ACCESS_KEY)
    82→
    83→    try:
    84→        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=_ctx(), timeout=timeout) as resp:
    85→            raw = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
    86→    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    87→        return {"error": f"HTTP {e.code}: {str(e)[:200]}"}
    88→    except Exception as e:

    90→
    91→    if 'event:' in raw or 'data:' in raw:
    92→        for line in raw.split('\n'):
    93→            if line.startswith('data:'):
    94→                data_str = line[5:].strip()
    95→                if data_str:
    96→                    try:
    97→                        return json.loads(data_str)
    98→                    except:
    99→                        continue
   100→
   101→    try:
   102→        return json.loads(raw)
   103→    except:
   104→        return {"error": "无法解析响应", "raw": raw[:500]}

   157→        if isinstance(obj, list):

   160→            if 'data' in obj and isinstance(obj['data'], list):

   162→            content = obj.get('content', [])
   163→            if content and isinstance(content, list):

   166→                    return extract_pages(inner, _depth + 1)
   167→                except:
   168→                    pass
   169→            result = obj.get('result', {})
   170→            if isinstance(result, dict):

   173→
   174→    pages = extract_pages(resp)

   493→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   494→    lines = md.split('\n')
   495→    cur = {}
   496→
   497→    for line in lines:
   498→        line = line.strip()
   499→        if not line:
   500→            if cur.get('name'):
   501→                products.append(cur)
   502→                cur = {}
   503→            continue
   504→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   505→            continue
   506→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   507→            if not cur.get('name'):
   508→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   509→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   510→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   511→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   512→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   513→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   514→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   515→
   516→    if cur.get('name'):
   517→        products.append(cur)
   518→    return products[:10]

   521→def filter_fresh(articles):
   522→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   523→    out = []
   524→    for a in articles:
   525→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   526→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   527→        if years:
   528→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   529→                out.append(a)
   530→        else:
   531→            out.append(a)
   532→    return out

   405→        'special offer', 'appliance package', 'skip to main', 'icon/error',
   406→        'order status', 'contact us', 'register', 'service & repair',

   412→        'made to work better', 'life is complicated', 'engineered for speed',
   413→        'meet your culinary', 'elevate your culinary', 'enjoy easy',
   414→        'power up your clean', 'brandlogo', 'brand logo',

   416→        'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap',
   417→        'warranty', 'delivery', 'help center', 'find a store',
   418→        'compare', 'wishlist', 'chat with', 'sign in', 'log in',
   419→        'create account', 'my account', 'cart', 'subscribe',

   422→        'mail icon', 'affirm.com', 'connects to your home',

   428→    # 纯分类导航词（短名且不含品牌/容量/型号信息）

   430→        r'^(french\s*door|side.by.side|top\s*freezer|'
   431→        r'counter.depth\s*(models)?|smart\s*refrigerator|'
   432→        r'refrigeration)$', re.IGNORECASE)
   433→
   434→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   435→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   436→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   437→
   438→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   439→            continue

   441→            continue
   442→        if name.startswith('!'):
   443→            continue
   444→
   445→        name_lower = name.lower()
   446→
   447→        if '\n' in name or '\\\\n' in name:
   448→            continue
   449→
   450→        if any(w in name_lower for w in noise):

   452→
   453→        # 纯分类导航词（如"French door"但非"Bespoke AI 4-Door French Door"）

   458→            continue
   459→
   460→        if re.search(r'(deals?|offer|sale|register|contact|support|service|parts|accessories|track|my-account|login|about|careers?|press|javascript)', url, re.IGNORECASE):
   461→            continue
   462→
   463→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   464→            if name not in seen:
   465→                seen.add(name)
   466→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   467→
   468→    # 非冰箱品类型号前缀 (烘干机/洗衣机/洗碗机)
   469→    non_fridge_prefix = re.compile(
   470→        r'^(MED|DV|WED|WGD|MVW|MVWB|WTW|WT|NTW|MHW|MHN|MGD|MLE|MLG|'
   471→        r'MDB|MDF|MDT|MDP|WDF|WDT|WDP|KDT|KDF|KDPE|KDTE|SHX|SHP|SHE|'
   472→        r'DW|DWV|DD|DP|GU|GC|GE|GP|GDT|GDF|GDP|GD|GF|GS|'
   473→        r'MMV|ME|MS|MC|NN|NE|NS|NX|SN|SE|SG)', re.IGNORECASE)
   474→
   475→    model_rx = [
   476→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   477→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   478→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   479→    ]
   480→    for rx in model_rx:
   481→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   482→            model = m.group(1).strip()

   484→                if re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   485→                    continue
   486→                if non_fridge_prefix.match(model):
   487→                    continue
   488→                if re.search(r'\d{2,4}x\d{2,4}', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   489→                    continue
   490→                if re.search(r'\d+inch', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   491→                    continue
   492→                if re.match(r'^[a-z]+-\d{6,}$', model, re.IGNORECASE):

   494→                # 过滤三星内部图片ID (SDSAC-*)
   495→                if re.match(r'^SDSAC', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   496→                    continue
   497→                if model not in seen:

   499→                    if not re.search(r'[A-Z]', model):

   505→
   506→    return items[:30]

   509→def extract_amazon(md):
   510→    products = []
   511→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   512→    lines = md.split('\n')
   513→    cur = {}
   514→
   515→    for line in lines:
   516→        line = line.strip()
   517→        if not line:
   518→            if cur.get('name'):
   519→                products.append(cur)
   520→                cur = {}
   521→            continue
   522→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   523→            continue
   524→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   525→            if not cur.get('name'):
   526→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   527→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   528→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   529→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   530→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   531→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   532→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   533→
   534→    if cur.get('name'):
   535→        products.append(cur)
   536→    return products[:10]

   539→def filter_fresh(articles):
   540→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   541→    out = []
   542→    for a in articles:
   543→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   544→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   545→        if years:
   546→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   547→                out.append(a)
   548→        else:
   549→            out.append(a)

   169→            result = obj.get('result', {})

   509→def extract_amazon(md):
   510→    products = []
   511→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   512→    lines = md.split('\n')
   513→    cur = {}
   514→
   515→    for line in lines:
   516→        line = line.strip()
   517→        if not line:
   518→            if cur.get('name'):
   519→                products.append(cur)
   520→                cur = {}
   521→            continue
   522→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   523→            continue
   524→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   525→            if not cur.get('name'):
   526→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   527→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   528→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   529→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   530→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   531→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   532→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   533→
   534→    if cur.get('name'):
   535→        products.append(cur)
   536→    return products[:10]

   539→def filter_fresh(articles):
   540→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   541→    out = []
   542→    for a in articles:
   543→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   544→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   545→        if years:
   546→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   547→                out.append(a)
   548→        else:
   549→            out.append(a)
   550→    return out

核心改动：**所有搜索从 Firecrawl `firecrawl_search` 切换到博查 `ai_search`**。

- 删除了 `fc_search()` 函数
- 新增 `bocha_search()` 函数，调用博查 AI 搜索 API
- `do_scrape`、`do_ecommerce`、`do_news` 的回退搜索全部改用 `bocha_search`

Firecrawl 的 search 端点对中文/英文查询都返回空，博查的 `ai_search` 之前专门用于中文行业新闻搜索，现在扩展到所有搜索场景。去跑一下看看。

    71→def mcp_call(mcp_url, tool, args, timeout=60):
    72→    body = json.dumps({
    73→        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    74→        "id": 1,
    75→        "method": "tools/call",
    76→        "params": {"name": tool, "arguments": args}
    77→    }).encode('utf-8')
    78→
    79→    req = urllib.request.Request(mcp_url, data=body, method='POST')
    80→    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    81→    req.add_header('X-Platform-Access-Key', ACCESS_KEY)
    82→
    83→    try:
    84→        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=_ctx(), timeout=timeout) as resp:
    85→            raw = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
    86→    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    87→        return {"error": f"HTTP {e.code}: {str(e)[:200]}"}
    88→    except Exception as e:
    89→        return {"error": str(e)[:200]}
    90→
    91→    if 'event:' in raw or 'data:' in raw:
    92→        for line in raw.split('\n'):
    93→            if line.startswith('data:'):
    94→                data_str = line[5:].strip()
    95→                if data_str:
    96→                    try:
    97→                        return json.loads(data_str)
    98→                    except:
    99→                        continue
   100→
   101→    try:
   102→        return json.loads(raw)
   103→    except:
   104→        return {"error": "无法解析响应", "raw": raw[:500]}

   150→def bocha_search(query, count=5):
   151→    """使用博查 AI 搜索"""
   152→    resp = mcp_call(BOCHA_MCP, "ai_search", {"query": query, "count": count, "answer": False})
   153→    articles = []
   154→
   155→    def extract_pages(obj, _depth=0):
   156→        if _depth > 10:
   157→            return []
   158→        if isinstance(obj, list):
   159→            return obj
   160→        if isinstance(obj, dict):
   161→            if 'webPages' in obj and isinstance(obj['webPages'], list):
   162→                return obj['webPages']
   163→            if 'data' in obj:
   164→                d = obj['data']
   165→                if isinstance(d, list):
   166→                    return d
   167→                if isinstance(d, dict):
   168→                    return extract_pages(d, _depth + 1)
   169→            content = obj.get('content', [])
   170→            if content and isinstance(content, list):
   171→                try:
   172→                    inner = json.loads(content[0].get('text', '{}'))
   173→                    return extract_pages(inner, _depth + 1)
   174→                except:
   175→                    pass
   176→            result = obj.get('result', {})
   177→            if isinstance(result, dict):
   178→                return extract_pages(result, _depth + 1)
   179→        return []
   180→
   181→    pages = extract_pages(resp)
   182→    for p in pages[:count]:
   183→        if isinstance(p, dict):
   184→            articles.append({
   185→                "title": (p.get('title', '') or p.get('name', '') or '').replace('\\', ''),
   186→                "snippet": (p.get('snippet', '') or p.get('summary', '') or '')[:200],
   187→                "url": p.get('url', ''),
   188→                "source": p.get('siteName', '') or p.get('source', '')
   189→            })
   190→    return articles

   407→def extract_from_md(md):

   412→        'special offer', 'appliance package', 'skip to main', 'icon/error',
   413→        'order status', 'contact us', 'register', 'service & repair',
   414→        'replacement parts', 'every day, care', 'recommendations',

   416→        'remove all', 'check eligibility', 'learn more', 'alt text',
   417→        'product ratings', 'number of ratings', 'track my order',
   418→        'bundle', 'package', 'deal', 'sale', 'closeout', 'outlet',
   419→        'made to work better', 'life is complicated', 'engineered for speed',
   420→        'meet your culinary', 'elevate your culinary', 'enjoy easy',
   421→        'power up your clean', 'brandlogo', 'brand logo',
   422→        'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'pinterest',
   423→        'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap',
   424→        'warranty', 'delivery', 'help center', 'find a store',
   425→        'compare', 'wishlist', 'chat with', 'sign in', 'log in',

   429→        'mail icon', 'affirm.com', 'connects to your home',
   430→        'washer', 'dryer', 'range', 'cooktop', 'hood', 'microwave',
   431→        'dishwasher', 'vacuum', 'air conditioner', 'dehumidifier',
   432→        'disposal', 'compactor', 'water heater',
   433→    ]
   434→
   435→    # 纯分类导航词（短名且不含品牌/容量/型号信息）
   436→    nav_only = re.compile(
   437→        r'^(french\s*door|side.by.side|top\s*freezer|'
   438→        r'counter.depth\s*(models)?|smart\s*refrigerator|'
   439→        r'refrigeration)$', re.IGNORECASE)
   440→
   441→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   442→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   443→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   444→
   445→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   446→            continue
   447→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   448→            continue
   449→        if name.startswith('!'):
   450→            continue
   451→
   452→        name_lower = name.lower()
   453→
   454→        if '\n' in name or '\\\\n' in name:
   455→            continue
   456→
   457→        if any(w in name_lower for w in noise):
   458→            continue
   459→

   461→        if nav_only.match(name):
   462→            continue
   463→
   464→        if re.search(r'\*\*.*ratings', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   465→            continue
   466→
   467→        if re.search(r'(deals?|offer|sale|register|contact|support|service|parts|accessories|track|my-account|login|about|careers?|press|javascript)', url, re.IGNORECASE):
   468→            continue
   469→
   470→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   471→            if name not in seen:
   472→                seen.add(name)
   473→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   474→
   475→    # 非冰箱品类型号前缀 (烘干机/洗衣机/洗碗机)
   476→    non_fridge_prefix = re.compile(

   150→def bocha_search(query, count=5):
   151→    """使用博查搜索：先 AI 搜索，空则回退 web 搜索"""
   152→    articles = []
   153→
   154→    def extract_pages(obj, _depth=0):
   155→        if _depth > 10:
   156→            return []
   157→        if isinstance(obj, list):
   158→            return obj
   159→        if isinstance(obj, dict):
   160→            if 'webPages' in obj and isinstance(obj['webPages'], list):
   161→                return obj['webPages']
   162→            if 'value' in obj and isinstance(obj['value'], list):
   163→                return obj['value']
   164→            if 'data' in obj:
   165→                d = obj['data']
   166→                if isinstance(d, list):
   167→                    return d
   168→                if isinstance(d, dict):
   169→                    return extract_pages(d, _depth + 1)
   170→            content = obj.get('content', [])
   171→            if content and isinstance(content, list):
   172→                try:
   173→                    inner = json.loads(content[0].get('text', '{}'))
   174→                    return extract_pages(inner, _depth + 1)
   175→                except:
   176→                    pass
   177→            result = obj.get('result', {})
   178→            if isinstance(result, dict):
   179→                return extract_pages(result, _depth + 1)
   180→        return []
   181→
   182→    def _collect(pages):
   183→        for p in pages[:count]:
   184→            if isinstance(p, dict):
   185→                articles.append({
   186→                    "title": (p.get('title', '') or p.get('name', '') or '').replace('\\', ''),
   187→                    "snippet": (p.get('snippet', '') or p.get('summary', '') or p.get('description', '') or '')[:200],
   188→                    "url": p.get('url', ''),
   189→                    "source": p.get('siteName', '') or p.get('source', '')
   190→                })
   191→
   192→    # 先试 ai_search
   193→    resp = mcp_call(BOCHA_MCP, "ai_search", {"query": query, "count": count, "answer": False})
   194→    _collect(extract_pages(resp))
   195→
   196→    # ai_search 空则回退 web_search
   197→    if not articles:
   198→        resp2 = mcp_call(BOCHA_MCP, "web_search", {"query": query, "count": count})
   199→        _collect(extract_pages(resp2))
   200→
   201→    return articles

   418→def extract_from_md(md):
   419→    seen = set()
   420→    items = []
   421→
   422→    noise = [
   423→        'special offer', 'appliance package', 'skip to main', 'icon/error',
   424→        'order status', 'contact us', 'register', 'service & repair',
   425→        'replacement parts', 'every day, care', 'recommendations',
   426→        'shop now', 'shop sales', 'shop closeout', 'view now',
   427→        'remove all', 'check eligibility', 'learn more', 'alt text',
   428→        'product ratings', 'number of ratings', 'track my order',
   429→        'bundle', 'package', 'deal', 'sale', 'closeout', 'outlet',
   430→        'made to work better', 'life is complicated', 'engineered for speed',
   431→        'meet your culinary', 'elevate your culinary', 'enjoy easy',
   432→        'power up your clean', 'brandlogo', 'brand logo',
   433→        'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'pinterest',
   434→        'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap',
   435→        'warranty', 'delivery', 'help center', 'find a store',
   436→        'compare', 'wishlist', 'chat with', 'sign in', 'log in',
   437→        'create account', 'my account', 'cart', 'subscribe',
   438→        'product information sheet', 'product help', 'homepage',
   439→        'find the best', 'view all faq', 'click here', 'close icon',
   440→        'mail icon', 'affirm.com', 'connects to your home',
   441→        'washer', 'dryer', 'range', 'cooktop', 'hood', 'microwave',
   442→        'dishwasher', 'vacuum', 'air conditioner', 'dehumidifier',
   443→        'disposal', 'compactor', 'water heater',
   444→    ]
   445→
   446→    # 纯分类导航词（短名且不含品牌/容量/型号信息）
   447→    nav_only = re.compile(
   448→        r'^(french\s*door|side.by.side|top\s*freezer|'
   449→        r'counter.depth\s*(models)?|smart\s*refrigerator|'
   450→        r'refrigeration)$', re.IGNORECASE)
   451→
   452→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   453→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   454→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   455→
   456→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   457→            continue
   458→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   459→            continue
   460→        if name.startswith('!'):
   461→            continue
   462→
   463→        name_lower = name.lower()
   464→
   465→        if '\n' in name or '\\\\n' in name:
   466→            continue
   467→
   468→        if any(w in name_lower for w in noise):
   469→            continue
   470→
   471→        # 纯分类导航词（如"French door"但非"Bespoke AI 4-Door French Door"）
   472→        if nav_only.match(name):
   473→            continue
   474→
   475→        if re.search(r'\*\*.*ratings', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   476→            continue
   477→
   478→        if re.search(r'(deals?|offer|sale|register|contact|support|service|parts|accessories|track|my-account|login|about|careers?|press|javascript)', url, re.IGNORECASE):
   479→            continue
   480→
   481→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   482→            if name not in seen:
   483→                seen.add(name)
   484→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   485→
   486→    # 非冰箱品类型号前缀 (烘干机/洗衣机/洗碗机)
   487→    non_fridge_prefix = re.compile(
   488→        r'^(MED|DV|WED|WGD|MVW|MVWB|WTW|WT|NTW|MHW|MHN|MGD|MLE|MLG|'
   489→        r'MDB|MDF|MDT|MDP|WDF|WDT|WDP|KDT|KDF|KDPE|KDTE|SHX|SHP|SHE|'
   490→        r'DW|DWV|DD|DP|GU|GC|GE|GP|GDT|GDF|GDP|GD|GF|GS|'
   491→        r'MMV|ME|MS|MC|NN|NE|NS|NX|SN|SE|SG)', re.IGNORECASE)
   492→
   493→    model_rx = [
   494→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   495→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   496→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   497→    ]
   498→    for rx in model_rx:
   499→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   500→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   501→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   502→                if re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   503→                    continue
   504→                if non_fridge_prefix.match(model):
   505→                    continue
   506→                if re.search(r'\d{2,4}x\d{2,4}', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   507→                    continue
   508→                if re.search(r'\d+inch', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   509→                    continue
   510→                if re.match(r'^[a-z]+-\d{6,}$', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   511→                    continue
   512→                # 过滤三星内部图片ID (SDSAC-*)
   513→                if re.match(r'^SDSAC', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   514→                    continue
   515→                if model not in seen:
   516→                    # 真实型号至少含1个大写字母+1个数字，过滤URL路径片段
   517→                    if not re.search(r'[A-Z]', model):
   518→                        continue
   519→                    if not re.search(r'\d', model):
   520→                        continue
   521→                    seen.add(model)
   522→                    items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   523→
   524→    return items[:30]

   527→def extract_amazon(md):
   528→    products = []
   529→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   530→    lines = md.split('\n')
   531→    cur = {}
   532→
   533→    for line in lines:
   534→        line = line.strip()
   535→        if not line:
   536→            if cur.get('name'):
   537→                products.append(cur)
   538→                cur = {}
   539→            continue
   540→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   541→            continue
   542→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   543→            if not cur.get('name'):
   544→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   545→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   546→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   547→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   548→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   549→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   550→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   551→
   552→    if cur.get('name'):
   553→        products.append(cur)
   554→    return products[:10]

   557→def filter_fresh(articles):
   558→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   559→    out = []
   560→    for a in articles:
   561→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   562→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   563→        if years:
   564→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   565→                out.append(a)
   566→        else:

   121→    if isinstance(resp, dict):

   127→        content = resp.get('content', [])

   136→        result = resp.get('result', {})
   137→        if isinstance(result, dict):
   138→            rcontent = result.get('content', [])

   150→def bocha_search(query, count=5):
   151→    """使用博查搜索：先 AI 搜索，空则回退 web 搜索"""
   152→    articles = []
   153→
   154→    def _extract_bocha(resp):
   155→        """博查 MCP 响应格式: {"code":200, "messages":[{"type":"source","content_type":"webpage","content":"<json>"}, ...]}"""
   156→        if not isinstance(resp, dict):
   157→            return []
   158→        msgs = resp.get('messages', [])
   159→        if not msgs:
   160→            return []
   161→        for msg in msgs:
   162→            if msg.get('content_type') != 'webpage':
   163→                continue
   164→            raw = msg.get('content', '')
   165→            if not raw:
   166→                continue
   167→            try:
   168→                inner = json.loads(raw)
   169→                if isinstance(inner, dict) and 'value' in inner:
   170→                    return inner['value']
   171→            except:
   172→                pass
   173→        return []
   174→
   175→    def _collect(pages):
   176→        for p in pages[:count]:
   177→            if isinstance(p, dict):
   178→                articles.append({
   179→                    "title": (p.get('name', '') or p.get('title', '') or '').replace('\\', ''),
   180→                    "snippet": (p.get('snippet', '') or p.get('summary', '') or p.get('description', '') or '')[:200],
   181→                    "url": p.get('url', ''),
   182→                    "source": p.get('siteName', '') or p.get('source', '')
   183→                })
   184→
   185→    # 先试 ai_search
   186→    resp = mcp_call(BOCHA_MCP, "ai_search", {"query": query, "count": count, "answer": False})
   187→    _collect(_extract_bocha(resp))
   188→
   189→    # ai_search 空则回退 web_search
   190→    if not articles:
   191→        resp2 = mcp_call(BOCHA_MCP, "web_search", {"query": query, "count": count})
   192→        _collect(_extract_bocha(resp2))
   193→
   194→    return articles

   411→def extract_from_md(md):
   412→    seen = set()
   413→    items = []
   414→
   415→    noise = [
   416→        'special offer', 'appliance package', 'skip to main', 'icon/error',
   417→        'order status', 'contact us', 'register', 'service & repair',
   418→        'replacement parts', 'every day, care', 'recommendations',
   419→        'shop now', 'shop sales', 'shop closeout', 'view now',
   420→        'remove all', 'check eligibility', 'learn more', 'alt text',
   421→        'product ratings', 'number of ratings', 'track my order',
   422→        'bundle', 'package', 'deal', 'sale', 'closeout', 'outlet',
   423→        'made to work better', 'life is complicated', 'engineered for speed',
   424→        'meet your culinary', 'elevate your culinary', 'enjoy easy',
   425→        'power up your clean', 'brandlogo', 'brand logo',
   426→        'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'pinterest',
   427→        'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap',
   428→        'warranty', 'delivery', 'help center', 'find a store',
   429→        'compare', 'wishlist', 'chat with', 'sign in', 'log in',
   430→        'create account', 'my account', 'cart', 'subscribe',
   431→        'product information sheet', 'product help', 'homepage',
   432→        'find the best', 'view all faq', 'click here', 'close icon',
   433→        'mail icon', 'affirm.com', 'connects to your home',
   434→        'washer', 'dryer', 'range', 'cooktop', 'hood', 'microwave',
   435→        'dishwasher', 'vacuum', 'air conditioner', 'dehumidifier',
   436→        'disposal', 'compactor', 'water heater',
   437→    ]
   438→
   439→    # 纯分类导航词（短名且不含品牌/容量/型号信息）
   440→    nav_only = re.compile(
   441→        r'^(french\s*door|side.by.side|top\s*freezer|'
   442→        r'counter.depth\s*(models)?|smart\s*refrigerator|'
   443→        r'refrigeration)$', re.IGNORECASE)
   444→
   445→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   446→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   447→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   448→
   449→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   450→            continue
   451→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   452→            continue
   453→        if name.startswith('!'):
   454→            continue
   455→
   456→        name_lower = name.lower()
   457→
   458→        if '\n' in name or '\\\\n' in name:
   459→            continue
   460→
   461→        if any(w in name_lower for w in noise):
   462→            continue
   463→
   464→        # 纯分类导航词（如"French door"但非"Bespoke AI 4-Door French Door"）
   465→        if nav_only.match(name):
   466→            continue
   467→
   468→        if re.search(r'\*\*.*ratings', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   469→            continue
   470→
   471→        if re.search(r'(deals?|offer|sale|register|contact|support|service|parts|accessories|track|my-account|login|about|careers?|press|javascript)', url, re.IGNORECASE):
   472→            continue
   473→
   474→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   475→            if name not in seen:
   476→                seen.add(name)
   477→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   478→
   479→    # 非冰箱品类型号前缀 (烘干机/洗衣机/洗碗机)
   480→    non_fridge_prefix = re.compile(
   481→        r'^(MED|DV|WED|WGD|MVW|MVWB|WTW|WT|NTW|MHW|MHN|MGD|MLE|MLG|'
   482→        r'MDB|MDF|MDT|MDP|WDF|WDT|WDP|KDT|KDF|KDPE|KDTE|SHX|SHP|SHE|'
   483→        r'DW|DWV|DD|DP|GU|GC|GE|GP|GDT|GDF|GDP|GD|GF|GS|'
   484→        r'MMV|ME|MS|MC|NN|NE|NS|NX|SN|SE|SG)', re.IGNORECASE)
   485→
   486→    model_rx = [
   487→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   488→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   489→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   490→    ]
   491→    for rx in model_rx:
   492→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   493→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   494→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   495→                if re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   496→                    continue
   497→                if non_fridge_prefix.match(model):
   498→                    continue
   499→                if re.search(r'\d{2,4}x\d{2,4}', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   500→                    continue
   501→                if re.search(r'\d+inch', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   502→                    continue
   503→                if re.match(r'^[a-z]+-\d{6,}$', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   504→                    continue
   505→                # 过滤三星内部图片ID (SDSAC-*)
   506→                if re.match(r'^SDSAC', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   507→                    continue
   508→                if model not in seen:
   509→                    # 真实型号至少含1个大写字母+1个数字，过滤URL路径片段
   510→                    if not re.search(r'[A-Z]', model):
   511→                        continue
   512→                    if not re.search(r'\d', model):
   513→                        continue
   514→                    seen.add(model)
   515→                    items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   516→
   517→    return items[:30]

   424→def extract_from_md(md):

   426→    items = []
   427→
   428→    noise = [
   429→        'special offer', 'appliance package', 'skip to main', 'icon/error',
   430→        'order status', 'contact us', 'register', 'service & repair',
   431→        'replacement parts', 'every day, care', 'recommendations',
   432→        'shop now', 'shop sales', 'shop closeout', 'view now',
   433→        'remove all', 'check eligibility', 'learn more', 'alt text',
   434→        'product ratings', 'number of ratings', 'track my order',
   435→        'bundle', 'package', 'deal', 'sale', 'closeout', 'outlet',
   436→        'made to work better', 'life is complicated', 'engineered for speed',
   437→        'meet your culinary', 'elevate your culinary', 'enjoy easy',
   438→        'power up your clean', 'brandlogo', 'brand logo',
   439→        'facebook', 'twitter', 'youtube', 'instagram', 'pinterest',
   440→        'privacy', 'terms', 'cookie', 'accessibility', 'sitemap',
   441→        'warranty', 'delivery', 'help center', 'find a store',
   442→        'compare', 'wishlist', 'chat with', 'sign in', 'log in',
   443→        'create account', 'my account', 'cart', 'subscribe',
   444→        'product information sheet', 'product help', 'homepage',
   445→        'find the best', 'view all faq', 'click here', 'close icon',
   446→        'mail icon', 'affirm.com', 'connects to your home',
   447→        'washer', 'dryer', 'range', 'cooktop', 'hood', 'microwave',
   448→        'dishwasher', 'vacuum', 'air conditioner', 'dehumidifier',
   449→        'disposal', 'compactor', 'water heater',
   450→    ]
   451→
   452→    # 纯分类导航词（短名且不含品牌/容量/型号信息）
   453→    nav_only = re.compile(
   454→        r'^(french\s*door|side.by.side|top\s*freezer|'
   455→        r'counter.depth\s*(models)?|smart\s*refrigerator|'
   456→        r'refrigeration)$', re.IGNORECASE)
   457→
   458→    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', md):
   459→        name = m.group(1).strip()
   460→        url = m.group(2).strip()
   461→
   462→        if re.search(r'\.(svg|png|jpg|gif|webp|ico)(\?|$)', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   463→            continue
   464→        if re.search(r'\$ORIGIN_IMG\$', name):
   465→            continue
   466→        if name.startswith('!'):
   467→            continue
   468→
   469→        name_lower = name.lower()
   470→
   471→        if '\n' in name or '\\\\n' in name:
   472→            continue
   473→
   474→        if any(w in name_lower for w in noise):
   475→            continue
   476→
   477→        # 纯分类导航词（如"French door"但非"Bespoke AI 4-Door French Door"）
   478→        if nav_only.match(name):
   479→            continue
   480→
   481→        if re.search(r'\*\*.*ratings', name, re.IGNORECASE):
   482→            continue
   483→
   484→        if re.search(r'(deals?|offer|sale|register|contact|support|service|parts|accessories|track|my-account|login|about|careers?|press|javascript)', url, re.IGNORECASE):
   485→            continue
   486→
   487→        if 8 <= len(name) <= 200:
   488→            if name not in seen:
   489→                seen.add(name)
   490→                items.append({"name": name, "url": url})
   491→
   492→    # 非冰箱品类型号前缀 (烘干机/洗衣机/洗碗机)
   493→    non_fridge_prefix = re.compile(
   494→        r'^(MED|DV|WED|WGD|MVW|MVWB|WTW|WT|NTW|MHW|MHN|MGD|MLE|MLG|'
   495→        r'MDB|MDF|MDT|MDP|WDF|WDT|WDP|KDT|KDF|KDPE|KDTE|SHX|SHP|SHE|'
   496→        r'DW|DWV|DD|DP|GU|GC|GE|GP|GDT|GDF|GDP|GD|GF|GS|'
   497→        r'MMV|ME|MS|MC|NN|NE|NS|NX|SN|SE|SG)', re.IGNORECASE)
   498→
   499→    model_rx = [
   500→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,6}[\-]?\d{2,6}[A-Z]{0,4}[A-Z0-9]{0,4})\b',
   501→        r'\b([A-Z]{2,4}\d{2,4}[A-Z]{2,4})\b',
   502→        r'Model\s*(?:NO\.|No|Number)?\s*[：:]*\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{6,15})',
   503→    ]
   504→    for rx in model_rx:
   505→        for m in re.finditer(rx, md, re.IGNORECASE):
   506→            model = m.group(1).strip()
   507→            if 5 <= len(model) <= 20 and not model.isdigit():
   508→                if re.match(r'^(HTTP|HTTPS|WWW|CSS|HTML|JS|API)', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   509→                    continue
   510→                if non_fridge_prefix.match(model):
   511→                    continue
   512→                if re.search(r'\d{2,4}x\d{2,4}', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   513→                    continue
   514→                if re.search(r'\d+inch', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   515→                    continue
   516→                if re.match(r'^[a-z]+-\d{6,}$', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   517→                    continue
   518→                # 过滤三星内部图片ID (SDSAC-*)
   519→                if re.match(r'^SDSAC', model, re.IGNORECASE):
   520→                    continue
   521→                if model not in seen:
   522→                    # 真实型号至少含1个大写字母+1个数字，过滤URL路径片段
   523→                    if not re.search(r'[A-Z]', model):
   524→                        continue
   525→                    if not re.search(r'\d', model):
   526→                        continue
   527→                    seen.add(model)
   528→                    items.append({"name": model, "model": model})
   529→
   530→    return items[:30]

   533→def extract_amazon(md):
   534→    products = []
   535→    price_rx = r'(?:€|EUR|USD|\$)\s*[\d.,]+'
   536→    lines = md.split('\n')
   537→    cur = {}
   538→
   539→    for line in lines:
   540→        line = line.strip()
   541→        if not line:
   542→            if cur.get('name'):
   543→                products.append(cur)
   544→                cur = {}
   545→            continue
   546→        if re.match(r'^(Sponsored|Gesponsert|Results|Ergebnisse|Filter|Sort|Page|Seite)', line, re.IGNORECASE):
   547→            continue
   548→        if len(line) > 30 and not line.startswith(('http', '//', '(', '[')):
   549→            if not cur.get('name'):
   550→                cur['name'] = line[:150]
   551→        pm = re.search(price_rx, line)
   552→        if pm and not cur.get('price'):
   553→            cur['price'] = pm.group(0)
   554→        rm = re.search(r'(\d+[.,]?\d*)\s*(?:out of|von|de)\s*5\s*(?:stars|Sternen)', line)
   555→        if rm and not cur.get('rating'):
   556→            cur['rating'] = rm.group(1)
   557→
   558→    if cur.get('name'):
   559→        products.append(cur)
   560→    return products[:10]

   563→def filter_fresh(articles):
   564→    this_year = datetime.now().year
   565→    out = []
   566→    for a in articles:
   567→        text = a.get('title', '') + ' ' + a.get('snippet', '')
   568→        years = re.findall(r'(20\d{2})', text)
   569→        if years:
   570→            if max(int(y) for y in years) >= this_year - 1:
   571→                out.append(a)
   572→        else:
   573→            out.append(a)
   574→    return out
